localModifications: Imported as directory mori/ of the Jiyuu monorepo; the project is being renamed Mori while the C binary keeps the name codebase-memory-mcp. The 164 vendored Tree-sitter grammars under internal/cbm/vendored/grammars/ (about 1.3 GB) are not committed: scripts/grammars-fetch.ts downloads a sha256-pinned archive of that directory at the source commit, recorded in grammars.lock.json, and checks every file against scripts/vendored-checksums.txt. Upstream CI workflows, the npm, PyPI, Go, Homebrew, Scoop, Chocolatey, winget and AUR publishing wrappers under pkg/ (and the Formula symlink into it), and the Claude Code plugin and marketplace manifests are excluded. Under tools/tree-sitter-*/ the hand-written grammar sources (grammar.js, external scanners, patches, corpus tests, package metadata and the sql LICENSE) are kept; the files tree-sitter generate writes (src/parser.c, src/grammar.json, src/node-types.json and the src/tree_sitter/ runtime headers, about 161 MB) are excluded because the build compiles the copies in the grammar archive and they can be regenerated from the kept sources. Upstream README.md is kept as README.upstream.md. Test edits: tests/test_cli.c reads README.upstream.md for the supported-agent contract and drops its pkg/npm/README.md assertions (the 46-surface sentence and the per-agent list); tests/test_language_count_contract.sh checks one surface, README.upstream.md, instead of two (README.md and the Chocolatey nuspec under pkg/); tests/test_vt_gate_policy_contract.sh reads README.upstream.md in place of README.md in both of its README checks. .gitignore gains a Jiyuu block ignoring the fetched internal/cbm/vendored/grammars/, .grammars.stamp and .grammars-tmp-*/. The upstream distribution files flake.nix, flake.lock, server.json, glama.json, install.sh and install.ps1 are removed; nothing in the build or the C suites reads them, and the scripts and contract tests that do (scripts/package-release.sh, scripts/smoke-local.sh, scripts/setup.sh, scripts/setup-windows.ps1, and the install_android_guard, mcpb_bundle, mcpb_registry_entries and setup_scripts contracts) are left unchanged. Adds Jiyuu documentation, a component justfile and Bun scripts for the grammar archive.
